tools.name: extract_emails
tools.description: Extract Outlook emails filtered by subject and sender, then save the result as CSV or JSON.

source_type.description: Email source: live Outlook profile or pst file.

pst_path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute .pst path. Required when source_type is pst.

subject_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter for email subject.

sender_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter for sender name or sender address.

include_body.description: Include the first 500 characters of the email body.
